titulo: Quiz — Nuki de — the two syllables that make the dish editable
introPt: A traveller edits one dish at the moment of ordering, and takes the on-the-side version when out is impossible.

dialogo.es: わさび抜きで、お願いします。
dialogo.tts: わさび抜きで、お願いします。

dialogo.es: わさび抜きですね。承知しました。ソースは？
dialogo.pt: Without wasabi, understood. And the sauce?
dialogo.tts: わさび抜きですね。承知しました。ソースは？

dialogo.es: ソースは別でお願いします。魚介抜きはできますか？
dialogo.pt: The sauce on the side, please. Can it be done without seafood?
dialogo.tts: ソースは別でお願いします。魚介抜きはできますか？

dialogo.es: 厨房で聞いてきます。出汁は魚ですが、大丈夫ですか？
dialogo.pt: I'll ask in the kitchen. The stock is fish, though — is that all right?
dialogo.tts: 厨房で聞いてきます。出汁は魚ですが、大丈夫ですか？

opcoes: It changes shape with the ingredient
The ingredient goes in plain, then nuki de after it, unchanged
It only works in questions
It has to start the sentence
perguntas.explica: Wasabi nuki de, koori nuki de, satou nuki de — the phrase never moves and never changes.

perguntas.pergunta: When is the request easiest to satisfy?
opcoes: When the plate arrives
At the moment of ordering
When you ask for the bill
After the first bite
perguntas.explica: A kitchen assembling to order can leave a thing out; a built plate can usually only be rearranged.

perguntas.pergunta: The staff say sousu wa mou haitte imasu, betsu no osara ni shimashou ka? That is:
opcoes: A refusal
A request for payment
An offer of the on-the-side version
A warning about an allergen
perguntas.explica: Betsu de moves it to the side of the plate instead of out of the dish.

perguntas.pergunta: You avoid meat and order a plain-looking vegetable dish. What is the hidden risk?
opcoes: It may be simmered in dashi — fish stock — so no meat is not no fish
Nothing, vegetables are always safe
It will contain pork by law
The price will double
perguntas.explica: Dashi from bonito and kelp is under a huge share of cooking; the reliable question is dashi wa sakana desu ka.

perguntas.pergunta: You have a real allergy. Is nuki de enough?
opcoes: Yes, it is the same request
Yes, if you say it twice
No — an allergy gets its own sentence and a written card
No, you should avoid restaurants
perguntas.explica: Preference and allergy are two different conversations, and the second one is the next part.
